PLAY · WHAT ANIMALS EAT

Lion’s Animal Food Lab

Time for animal lunch! Tap an animal, then tap the food it really eats.

Tap an animal, then tap the food it eats.

Lunch is served!

The lion munches meat, the rabbit nibbles grass and leafy plants, and the panda crunches bamboo.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Herbivore, carnivore, and the panda’s famous bamboo habit — three diets, three teeth stories. Ask which one YOUR child eats: usually a bit of everything!

Prefer paper? The Lion’s Animal Food Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
